description: Dirección de flujos de drenajes zona rural Bogotá D.C. is a dataset listed in City of Bogotá open data portal (Datos Abiertos Bogotá), an open data portal, published or maintained by Infraestructura de Datos Espaciales para el Distrito Capital - IDECA. El mapa de la dirección del flujo calcula la dirección en que el agua fluirá usando la pendiente de las celdas vecinas. Coverage: Bogotá. The portal files it under the publisher Infraestructura de Datos Espaciales para el Distrito Capital - IDECA. Its tags are Drenajes, UAECD, flujo, zona rural. It offers 2 resource(s) in ESRI REST, WMS. The portal shows 2022-03-09 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support urban drainage and flood-risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-bogota-portal.
